title: Finite free sheaf monomorphisms give normalized K-flat cokernel resolutions
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Work with sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $m,n\geq0$ and let $P,Q$ be module sheaves equipped with isomorphisms $P\cong R^{\oplus m}$ and $Q\cong R^{\oplus n}$, where the powers denote finite direct sums of the regular module sheaf. Let $u:P\to Q$ be any monomorphism and let $T=\operatorname{coker}(u)$ with its specified cokernel projection $q:Q\to T$. Define the cochain complex $C_u$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] by $C_u^{-1}=P$, $C_u^0=Q$, $d^{-1}=u$, and zero terms and differentials elsewhere. Its augmentation $\epsilon:C_u\to T[0]$, with $\epsilon^0=q$ and all other components zero, is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Every term of $C_u$, $P[0]$ and $Q[0]$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and all three complexes are K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. In particular this specified augmentation is a K-flat resolution of $T[0]$. Here $N[0]$ places a module sheaf $N$ in degree zero. Equivalently $C_u$ is canonically identified with $\operatorname{Cone}(u[0])$, with differential $+u$, and the augmentation is normalized by $Q[0]\to C_u\xrightarrow{\epsilon}T[0]=q[0]$. No scalar origin of $u$ or constant-coefficient origin of $R$ is assumed.
